ideas.title: Investigating Minnesota's Fraud Epidemic
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including the case of a personal care assistant accused of billing Medicaid for services not provided.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud problem in Minnesota?
How are state officials responding to the issue?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the scope of the problem and the efforts being made to address it, and could potentially lead to further investigations and reforms.
